Package models

package models
Domain model classes: users, courses, grades, messaging, and registration workflow.
  • Class
    Description
    Admin
    Administrator with full system access.
    Course
    Serializable course entity with teachers, enrolled students, and scheduled lessons.
    CourseRegistrationRequest
    Student request to enroll in a course; may be pending, approved, or rejected.
    CourseRegistrationRequest.Status
    Lifecycle state of a registration request.
    Lesson
    Scheduled lesson belonging to a course and taught by a teacher.
    Manager
    Manager who can publish and remove campus news.
    Mark
    Grade record for a student in a course (two attempts plus final exam).
    Message
    Inbox message with sender, body, and timestamp.
    Student
    Student user with course enrollment, marks, and transcript support.
    Teacher
    Teacher user assigned to courses; also acts as a Researcher.
    Transcript
    Academic summary for a student: GPA, earned credits, and fail count.
